title: kith-tui Cargo: add chrono dependency
description:
**What:** Add chrono 0.4 to kith-tui Cargo.toml for RFC 3339 timestamp generation.

**Algorithm:**
1. Check workspace Cargo.toml for existing chrono entry — not present.
2. Add to [workspace.dependencies]: chrono = { version = '0.4', features = ['serde'] }
3. Add to crates/kith-tui/Cargo.toml [dependencies]: chrono.workspace = true
4. Run cargo check -p kith-tui to confirm no resolver conflicts.

**Defensive rules:**
- Do not pin to a minor version; use '0.4' (semver-compatible).
- Only add the 'serde' feature (needed for Option<DateTime> in JMAP); do NOT add 'std' explicitly (implied).
- Do not add any other chrono features.

**Agent team:** R reads workspace Cargo.toml + kith-tui Cargo.toml; I adds the dep lines; V runs cargo check.
